question: What kind of person is condemned as a mockery of the Kula teaching?
premises: A person driven by greed is described
Such a person is fickle and unsteady
This person is called a mockery of the Kula scripture
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle is a mockery of the Kula teaching
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
